lessons.lesson: 每日文章 · 2026-10-02 · AI at Work

words.example: These tools can write emails, translate documents and even plan meetings, saving people a lot of time.
words.example_zh: 呢啲工具可以寫電郵、翻譯文件，甚至安排會議，幫大家慳返好多時間。

words.example: These tools can write emails, translate documents and even plan meetings, saving people a lot of time.
words.example_zh: 呢啲工具可以寫電郵、翻譯文件，甚至安排會議，幫大家慳返好多時間。

words.example: However, we should learn how to use them wisely.
words.example_zh: 不過，我哋應該學識點樣明智噉用佢哋。

words.example: For example, my colleague Mandy used to spend two hours writing a weekly report.
words.example_zh: 例如，我同事 Mandy 以前要用兩個鐘寫一份週報。

words.example: Now an AI tool helps her prepare a first draft in ten minutes, allowing her to focus on more important work.
words.example_zh: 而家 AI 工具幫佢十分鐘就整好初稿，令佢可以專心做更重要嘅工作。

words.example: Now an AI tool helps her prepare a first draft in ten minutes, allowing her to focus on more important work.
words.example_zh: 而家 AI 工具幫佢十分鐘就整好初稿，令佢可以專心做更重要嘅工作。

words.example: If we copy its answers without checking them, we may make serious mistakes.
words.example_zh: 如果我哋唔檢查就照抄佢嘅答案，可能會犯嚴重錯誤。

words.example: Another problem is that some workers worry about losing their jobs.
words.example_zh: 另一個問題係，有啲員工擔心會失業。

words.example: Although this worry is understandable, AI cannot replace people who keep learning.
words.example_zh: 雖然呢種擔心可以理解，但係 AI 取代唔到不斷學習嘅人。

words.example: Although this worry is understandable, AI cannot replace people who keep learning.
words.example_zh: 雖然呢種擔心可以理解，但係 AI 取代唔到不斷學習嘅人。

words.example: Companies should let their staff try these tools and provide training, making everyone feel more confident.
words.example_zh: 公司應該畀員工試用呢啲工具，同埋提供培訓，令大家更有信心。

words.example: In the end, people who are willing to learn will always find a place in the workplace.
words.example_zh: 總括嚟講，願意學習嘅人喺職場永遠都會有一席之地。
